diagrams.title: End-to-End Component Flow
diagrams.content:
flowchart LR
    User([User]) --> DiagramPill[Diagram Pill]
    DiagramPill --> PromptPeekModal[PromptPeekModal]
    PromptPeekModal --> SendPreviewModal[SendPreviewModal]
    SendPreviewModal --> PTY[PTY Terminal Tab]
    PTY --> Agent[AI Agent]
    Agent --> Sidecar[.diagrams.json]
    Sidecar --> Poll[Poll 5x600ms]
    Poll --> uiStore[uiStore]
    uiStore --> GalleryPanel[DiagramGalleryPanel]
    GalleryPanel --> DiagramCard[DiagramCard]
    DiagramCard --> DiagramRender[DiagramRender]
    DiagramRender --> Lightbox[DiagramLightbox]

diagrams.title: Mermaid Render Pipeline
diagrams.content:
flowchart TD
    DiagramCard[DiagramCard] --> useEffect[useEffect\ndeps: content, theme]
    useEffect -->|already loaded| skipImport[Skip dynamic import]
    useEffect -->|first call| lazyImport[lazy import mermaid]
    lazyImport --> getStyle[getComputedStyle\nCSS tokens]
    getStyle --> initialize[m.initialize\ntheme + securityLevel]
    initialize --> mRender[m.render\nunique id per call]
    mRender -->|unmount guard| setSvg[setSvg\nsanitized SVG]
    setSvg --> innerHTML[dangerouslySetInnerHTML]
    mRender -->|error| preFallback[pre fallback\nerror note]
    useEffect -->|theme flip| initialize

diagrams.title: Diagram Pill State Machine
diagrams.content:
flowchart TD
    FileSwitch([file switch]) -->|resets to| NONE
    NONE[NONE] -->|handleDiagram called| RUNNING
    RUNNING["RUNNING\nspinner · Diagramming…"] -->|PTY exit + poll success| DONE
    RUNNING -->|PTY stop| ERROR
    RUNNING -->|poll fail / parse fail| ERROR
    DONE["DONE\n🖼 N chip · panel opens"] -->|click Run again| RUNNING
    DONE -->|error| ERROR
    ERROR["ERROR\nred border · retry toast"] -->|clearIfStill| NONE
